'''Halacc Demior''' was an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked at [[Callia's]] aboard the ''[[Cal Ambre]]'' as part of [[Retter Lewis]]' pipeline for transporting defecting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]]. An expert combatant, he served as Lewis' [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and as the shop's [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]].
